channel.title: Zig Guide Live
channel.description: A Zig tutorial and cookbook. Each build compiles and runs every snippet against current Zig master, and the snippets run in your browser as WebAssembly.

item.title: Read the Frames Yourself
item.description: A frame reader for the server. It joins fragments, returns the close code, checks UTF-8 and the size, and maps each failure to a close code.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The Hub
item.description: One writer for each socket. The hub keeps the members, copies each line into a bounded outbox, and never touches a socket.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The Protocol
item.description: Commands in, events out. A text protocol inside WebSocket messages, a tagged union for each direction, and a line size that the compiler checks.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Slow Clients
item.description: A member that does not read fills its outbox. The hub puts with a minimum of 0, drops the member when nothing fits, and the room does not wait.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The Server
item.description: The protocol, the hub and the frame reader on real sockets. A reader task and a writer task for each connection, and three clients that chat.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: What You Will Build
item.description: A chat room over WebSocket with only the standard library, and the four decisions that the next chapters make.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: A WebSocket Client
item.description: A client that std does not have. It checks the handshake, masks each frame, puts fragments together, answers a ping, and closes correctly.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: WebSocket Frames
item.description: The two header bytes as packed structs, the three length forms, the client mask, and the frames that std.http.Server refuses.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The WebSocket Handshake
item.description: An HTTP request asks to upgrade, std.http.Server answers 101, and the checks that std leaves to your code.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: A WebSocket Server on a Socket
item.description: std.http.Server upgrades a real TCP connection and echoes messages. The server answers pings, closes correctly, and refuses a message that is too big.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Binary Search
item.description: The half-open window, the invariant that keeps the window correct, and the two bounds that std already has.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: A Contest Template
item.description: The one program in the section that reads real stdin, and three problems that a judge finds and a browser never shows.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Merge Intervals
item.description: A sort by start for one pass, the nested interval that shortens a run without @max, and a sweep that counts open intervals.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The Monotonic Stack
item.description: A stack of the indices that still wait for an answer, and the two counters that show the inner loop keeps the total linear.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Prefix Sums and Difference Arrays
item.description: One subtraction instead of a loop, an extra cell for index 0, and the same method in reverse for range updates.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Two Pointers
item.description: Two indices that start at opposite ends, and the argument that tells which index must move.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union)
item.description: Groups that merge when edges arrive. A merge moves one root in a parent array, and a find follows links to the root.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Read Line by Line
item.description: A line loop over a file, three types of line ending, a line longer than the buffer, and a large file through a small buffer.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: The Monotonic Deque
item.description: The largest value in each window, from a deque with two ends that remove indices for two different reasons.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Installation
item.description: How to get a Zig master build, and why this guide needs one.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: What Changed in Zig 0.17
item.description: The changes between 0.16.0 and 0.17.0, checked on the two compilers.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Build Lookup Tables
item.description: The compiler calculates a CRC-32 table, and the program checks it against the standard library.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Everything Is Bytes
item.description: A type is not a property of the bytes. A type is an agreement about how to read the bytes.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Structs Are Layout
item.description: Fields are next to each other in memory, and the size is not the sum of the parts.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Take or Skip: The 0/1 Knapsack
item.description: All subsets, the take-or-skip recursion, the table that stops repeats, the walk back to the items, and the one-row version with its loop direction.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Breadth-First Search on a Grid
item.description: The distance field as the frontier grows, and the one line with a position that decides if a cell can enter the queue two times.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Sliding Window
item.description: One addition and one subtraction instead of a new sum, the window that grows and shrinks, and the count that shows the total stays linear.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Project: Parse Arguments from a Struct
item.description: The fields of a struct are the options. The compiler makes the parser and the help text.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Reject Bad Input with @compileError
item.description: Check the type that a generic function receives, and stop the build with a message that names the problem.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Dispatch with Comptime
item.description: Connect each tag of an enum to its handler at compile time, with a switch or with a table.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Project: A Typed Event Bus
item.description: Handlers are plain functions. The bus reads their parameter types and connects each one to its event during compilation.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Know the Limits
item.description: What comptime code cannot do, what to use instead, and what comptime costs.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Parse Strings at Compile Time
item.description: Parse a route pattern during compilation, and make a struct type for its parameters.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Project: Units of Measure
item.description: A number type that carries its unit. Metres times metres is an area, and metres plus seconds does not compile.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Comptime
item.description: Usual Zig code that the compiler runs.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Know What the Compiler Knows
item.description: The rule that decides which values the compiler can use, and four ways to use them.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Make a Type
item.description: Make integer, struct, enum and tuple types from comptime values, and write a Partial(T) patch type.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Read a Type
item.description: Use @typeInfo to list the fields of a struct, an enum and a union, then write a generic diff.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Paint
item.description: A rectangle of memory, filled from back to front. The last write wins.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Emit an Executable
item.description: How to build without a build.zig.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Generate Documentation
item.description: Doc comments, and the site that Zig makes from them.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Async, Future and Group
item.description: async, Future, and Group, all through the Io interface.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: A Batch Job Runner
item.description: Four workers, one batch, three kinds of shared state, and a measurement that says one thread did all of the work.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Choose an Io
item.description: Threaded, the evented implementations, and how to build an Io yourself.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Migrate from `std.Thread`
item.description: Seven names that Zig removed, where each one went, and why lock can now fail.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Keep It Balanced
item.description: Store a height, check it after each insert, and repair the shape with a local rotation. Four cases, and each case has five lines or fewer.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Make It Generic
item.description: Zig has no generics syntax. A generic container is a function that takes a type and returns a type at compile time.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: A Linked List by Hand
item.description: The smallest structure that needs an allocator, an optional pointer and a deinit with the correct order.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Binary Files
item.description: A small binary format with a header, written one field at a time, and a reader that checks each byte that it did not write.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai

item.title: Read CSV
item.description: A CSV reader as a state machine with four states, a trace of each byte, the errors of a comma split, and line numbers.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
